clean_copy: project/ = git archive of the source commit (no build outputs), plus the package files; the two cores vendored as sources under vendor/; no object of the development or of the cores was reused; LEAN_PATH = this package's .lake/build/lib/lean and the nine pinned dependency packages only
records_note: Each peak is the cumulative process-tree peak of its replay invocation, hence an upper bound for the module. free_before_bytes = min(Linux MemAvailable, Windows host heartbeat ullAvailPhys). fresh_full_replay = one replay from an empty build directory (no --resume) of every module reachable from the package roots; later_records = any module rebuilt afterwards.
